name: LinkedIn Native Video
strategic_objective: Authority building, education, leadership presence, and professional storytelling through motion.

tone: Clear, structured, and professional. Confident without being promotional.
copywriting_rules: Open the video with the business problem, question, or learning in the first 2 seconds. Subtitles are mandatory for retention. The caption should summarize the key takeaway and set expectation for the viewer.
Line 1–2: problem or promise. Body: what the viewer will learn. Final line: outcome-oriented CTA.
Ensure comprehension in sound-off viewing and reinforce the main point.
Sync text with the spoken message
Tag speakers, companies, or partners visible in the video.

required_generation_elements: Clear verbal hook in the first seconds
hard_constraints: Repeating the full script in the caption
Using horizontal-only visuals with unreadable text
